docs.description: The National Compensation Survey (NCS) is an annual survey of the incidence and provisions of selected benefits provided by employers. The survey collects data from a sample of approximately 18,000 private sector and State and local government establishments.  The data are presented as a percentage of employees with access to employee benefit programs and for some benefits, percentage of employees who participate in them.
